<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/sources/{sourceID}/containers/{containerID}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes the container and its descendant subtree plus every
document inside, across all stores. Refuses (409) if the
container or an ancestor is claimed by a corpus; branches
claimed by another corpus are pruned and preserved.
